title: AAPS freezes if BT communication with Medtrum is disrupted
symptom: AAPS freezes when BT communication with Medtrum is disrupted, e.g., when leaving the room. The app interface becomes blank or unusable, Android reports that AAPS is not responding, and restarting the app fixes the problem. Freezes also occurred after syncing with Nightscout without Medtrum involvement.
evidence_quote: Since I haven't observed any more freezes with the new dev versions, I'm closing the issue.
